name: OpenArt
original_description: Create images and videos on OpenArt without leaving ChatGPT, from UGC ads, presenter and talking-head videos to brand commercials, paid social ads and product listing videos. Describe what you want, add reference images if you like, and pick from the latest AI models: Seedance 2.5 / 2.0, Kling 4.0, GPT Image 2.5, Nano Banana Pro / 2, Minimax H3 / H3 max, Gemini Omni Flash, Wan 3.0, and more. OpenArt generates it and brings the result back into the chat, updating as it finishes, so you can go from an idea to a finished image or video in a single conversation. No editing tools required. Revisit your past creations anytime, keep your work organized in projects, and check your credit balance as you go. New models appear here automatically as OpenArt adds them.
